title: Book Three · Chapter 186: The Hill on Sunday
story:
By the third Friday in January, Ronan has received two more weekly payments of thirty yuan.

His work envelope holds one hundred and fifty-nine. At the January household review, Dad adds twelve and Mum eight to their study money.

The parents now keep two hundred and twenty. With Ronan's work money and his old twenty and a half, the saved total is three hundred and ninety-nine and a half.

Leo's twenty-fourth reply arrives during those weeks. His four shop mornings are complete. He liked the stock work and has agreed to more part-time work there for three months.

He has stayed in his own city. He asks Ronan about the final school days and sends a joke for Kai.

On Sunday, Ronan tells Anna the news as they walk up the park hill.

The path is dry. There are low steps near the top, and Anna counts them without thinking.

“Another stair?” he asks.

She laughs. “A better one than mine.”

They reach the seat near the top. Ronan sits and stretches his legs.

Below them, the roofs make a close grey line. He can find the workshop road, though the shop itself is hidden.

Anna points to the taller building beside the square.

“That roof catches the light.”

He follows her finger. He usually looks at its door and the people below.

For a while, they watch the little movements along the road. A cart turns, two people stop, and someone opens a bright umbrella.

“No forms up here,” Anna says.

“Only steps.”

She moves closer and takes his hand. He rubs her cold fingers gently between his own.

“Long week?” she asks.

“Good week. My feet are tired.”

Anna looks down at his shoes.

“Then we can stay here a little longer.”

“I would like that.”

He folds Leo's letter and puts it in his bag. Anna moves the bag behind their feet to make more room on the seat.

She rests her head against his shoulder for a moment. Ronan watches the umbrella move along the street and vanish beneath a roof.

On the way down, he tells her about the larger gift box. She tells him about a younger student's very careful triangle.

They stop at the lower gate, where their roads separate. Anna gives his hand one last squeeze.

Ronan walks home more slowly than usual. At the green door, Dad is sitting in the winter light. Ronan sits beside him and opens Leo's letter to share the part about the shop.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

stock＝存货；part-time＝非全天的、部分时间的；stretch＝伸展；vanish＝从视线里消失。

## 理解问题

1. 三周工资与一月家存实际入账后，三份钱合计多少？Leo的钱是否属于Ronan？
2. 这次山坡散步，两人各注意什么、怎样分享自己的生活与亲近？

## 读句子

**She moves closer and takes his hand.**

拆开看：She / moves closer / and takes his hand.

她／挪近一些／并牵住他的手。
